entries.subject: Reviewed USGS Borrelly terrain
entries.finding: The reviewed PDS release supplies the observed USGS surface. Its 16 m posts oversample roughly 150 m stereo terrain; image-plane heights are not radius or an absolute gravity datum.

entries.subject: Independent DLR terrain
entries.finding: The DLR dataset uses its own retained geometry after a documented image-plane and vertical-datum registration to USGS. The mapping paper does not supply that final transform; the saved fit is part of this package.

entries.subject: Mission MICAS orthophoto and XYZ cubes
entries.finding: The four original cubes account for every valid USGS post and establish photograph placement. They came from a rescued mission website outside formal PDS product review; this correspondence does not establish radiometric calibration.

entries.subject: USGS image-plane height
entries.finding: Height displays source Z in kilometres before the presentation translation. Negative and zero values remain valid; it is displacement above an arbitrary image plane.

entries.subject: USGS minus registered DLR height
entries.finding: Difference is restricted to the intersection of the released surfaces. It includes registration sensitivity of about 200–206 m RMS and is not physical surface change.

entries.subject: Unobserved rear and interior gaps
entries.finding: The scene retains an explicitly estimated completion with grid material. Its rear shape and 3.15 km depth are display assumptions; source-fit measurements exclude them.

entries.subject: Individual raw MICAS near and mid images
entries.finding: These products were retained as archive references. The selected orthophoto already provides documented terrain registration; an independent multi-frame photographic mosaic has not been qualified.
entries.revisitWhen: Individual frames gain reproducible camera-to-terrain registration and improve coverage or useful detail over the orthophoto.

entries.subject: Published Borrelly photometry as a scalar map
entries.finding: The consulted DEM and rescued-website archives supplied no established machine-readable, registered scalar albedo release. The photometric analysis remains paper evidence; this is a bounded archive finding.
entries.revisitWhen: A released scalar table or reproducible paper method supplies registration, validity and calibration for this source terrain.

entries.subject: Press images and 8 by 4 by 4 km illustrations
entries.finding: These are context references and do not observe or close the unobserved rear. They are not substituted for the measured terrain or used to hide the grid.
entries.revisitWhen: New observations actually constrain the missing surface.

entries.subject: Four MICAS terrain-unit places
entries.finding: Upper Mottled Terrain, Central Mesas, Central Smooth Terrain and Lower Mottled Terrain transfer through measured map-to-photo and photo-to-orthophoto controls. They are approximate interiors on the MICAS source mesh, not exact boundaries or DLR labels.

entries.subject: Lower Smooth Terrain label
entries.finding: The selected point lies too near the photograph support edge for the broad placement check. It remains withheld while the four interior places are included.
entries.revisitWhen: A supported interior point or additional registered coverage passes the existing placement check.
